# THIRD_PARTY notices

janitor-prime is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE-MIT,
LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE). This manifest lists every third-party crate in
its dependency graph and the license under which it ships. It is
**generated by [cargo-about] 0.9** from `Cargo.lock` via `about.toml` +
`about.hbs` (the F7 decision record: cargo-about was available locally,
so the manifest is machine-generated rather than hand-maintained; the
`cargo deny check licenses` gate in CI enforces the same allow list
mechanically). Regenerate and re-commit whenever `Cargo.lock` moves.
